# Edgard Vargas

> Director General y fundador de Bridge. Lidera la conversación sobre inteligencia artificial en medianas y grandes empresas de México.

Edgard Vargas is the CEO and founder of Bridge, a software, data, and digital marketing studio based in Guadalajara, Mexico (since 2013). He leads the conversation on where AI belongs inside mid-size and large companies. Bridge builds. Edgard sets the criterion.
